summary: Known purestorage.flasharray issues: all Fusion fleet members are assumed to run the same Purity//FA version as the connected array, and FlashArray//CBS isn't supported as a fleet member.
questions: Can a FlashArray//CBS be part of a Fusion fleet managed by Ansible?
Does Ansible handle mixed Purity versions in a Fusion fleet?

answer_card.title: purestorage.flasharray Fusion fleet limits
answer_card.answer_md:
- All Fusion fleet members are assumed to run the same Purity//FA version as the array Ansible connects to.
- FlashArray//CBS isn't supported as a Fusion fleet member.
